premises.text: Big data can transform animal health management similar to its impact on human medicine
premises.evidence_span: the power that big data has done in transforming human medicine

premises.text: Animal health poses significant economic risks due to disease outbreaks
premises.evidence_span: Just one single virus in 2014 decimated the pig population, destroying livelihoods, but also dramatically affecting the price of pork

premises.text: New and emerging diseases in humans often originate from animals
premises.evidence_span: 70% of all new and emerging diseases in humans come from animals

premises.text: The animal health industry spends significantly on developing new drugs and treatments
premises.evidence_span: the industry spends over $20 billion a year developing new drugs and treatments to try to manage these diseases

premises.text: Preventable losses in animal health could amount to billions if diseases are caught early
premises.evidence_span: $13 billion in losses can be prevented if we were able to catch them early on

premises.text: Combining historic and real-time data can provide a comprehensive view of animal health
premises.evidence_span: we bring in historic and real-time data, and then we combine it into one standard format

premises.text: Veterinarians can diagnose diseases more accurately and efficiently using the platform
premises.evidence_span: livestock veterinarians can more accurately and efficiently diagnose disease at point of care

premises.text: The platform helps veterinarians find effective treatments for diseases
premises.evidence_span: livestock veterinarians can then find the most efficient and most effective treatments to cure the disease

premises.text: The platform enables pharmaceutical companies to identify new gene targets and pathogens
premises.evidence_span: our platform also enables the pharmaceutical industry to find new gene targets and pathogens

premises.text: The platform can predict causal genes for antibiotic resistance in pathogens
premises.evidence_span: we're able to predict the causal genes for this emerging trait, which in this case was antibiotic resistance

premises.text: The platform can assist in developing new drugs faster by providing critical data
premises.evidence_span: giving the drug development scientist critical data to develop a new drug faster

premises.text: The company leverages a natural network effect from customer-vendor relationships
premises.evidence_span: we take advantage of a natural network effect from their customer-vendor relationships

premises.text: The company plans to expand into precision husbandry as their database grows
premises.evidence_span: as our database grows, is to go into what we're calling precision husbandry

value.text: Animal health management becomes more precise and effective through data integration
value.evidence_span: bring precision medicine to the animal health industry

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships coded.
